newsitem.title: USA: Witco sees Q4 restructure charge of $421 mln.
newsitem.headline: Witco sees Q4 restructure charge of $421 mln.

text.p: Witco Corp said on Thursday it will pursue a major corporate restructuring plan that calls for a reduction in annual operating costs of more than $200 million by the end of 1999.

The company said it will take a fourth quarter pre-tax charge-off to earnings of $421 million, for restructuring charges, and for other items which include environmental and safety compliance, litigation provisions and inventory writedowns.
The company said the plan anticipates a consolidation in worldwide manufacturing facilities from 46 to 31, as well as consolidation of certain related distribution and administrative centers.
During this same period, the company said it will invest more than $600 million of internally generated funds to drive future earnings growth and increase R&D support.

The company said this investment includes about $250 million for new capacity to support future business growth, about $200 million to modernize the remaining plants and replace the capacity in closed facilities in a way that ensures no interruption in shipments or services to customers, about $100 million for environmental, safety and other items and about $50 million to upgrade worldwide information systems.
Under the plan the company said a reduction in employment of about 1,800 people will occur over the three-year period from the current level of 6,800.
